strings.name: Jack Ma
strings.summary: Jack Ma co-founded Alibaba and served as its CEO and executive chairman. Moving from teaching English into internet entrepreneurship, he helped develop e-commerce platforms and online payments. After stepping down as chairman in 2019, he devoted more attention to educational philanthropy. His business career has also involved questions of platform governance and financial regulation; the suspension of Ant Group’s listing in 2020 was an important turning point.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones in entrepreneurship, corporate governance and philanthropy, with the main chronology ending in 2023. Corporate developments should not be treated as achievements accomplished by one individual alone.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Graduated in English from Hangzhou Teachers College in 1988
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Associated businesses
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Co-founding Alibaba
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Started the business with a team in Hangzhou in 1999, building an online trading platform for businesses.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Developing consumer e-commerce
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Alibaba launched Taobao in 2003 and subsequently expanded supporting services such as online payments.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: Educational philanthropy
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Established the Jack Ma Foundation in 2014 to support rural education and other charitable projects.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Ant Group changes its control structure
strings.timeline.event-01.text: The company announced changes to shareholder voting rights, after which Ma no longer controlled Ant Group.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Ant Group’s listing is suspended
strings.timeline.event-02.text: The Shanghai Stock Exchange suspended Ant Group’s listing on the STAR Market, marking an important turning point for the business.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Steps down as Alibaba executive chairman
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Ended his term as chairman; his tenure as CEO had already ended in 2013.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Establishes a charitable foundation
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Founded and funded the Jack Ma Foundation, focusing on education and other charitable causes.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Alibaba lists in New York
strings.timeline.event-05.text: The group listed on the New York Stock Exchange, entering a new phase in the capital markets.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Steps down as group CEO
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Ended his tenure as CEO, held since the group’s founding, while remaining executive chairman.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Taobao launches
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Alibaba established Taobao as an online trading platform for individual consumers and merchants.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Co-founds Alibaba
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Launched the business with his founding team in a Hangzhou apartment, initially focusing on business-to-business online trade.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Founds China Pages
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Started an online business-directory venture, gaining early experience in internet business services.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Completes his English degree
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Worked as an English teacher after graduation, later moving into translation services and internet entrepreneurship.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Born in Hangzhou
strings.timeline.event-11.text: Born and raised in Hangzhou; learning English became an important part of his early life.
